definitions.explanation: A pitch thrown at high speed in baseball. The most basic and common type of pitch.

examples.japanese: {速球|そっきゅう}を{投|な}げた。
{彼|かれ}の{速球|そっきゅう}は150キロを{超|こ}える。
バッターは{速球|そっきゅう}に{振|ふ}り{遅|おく}れて{三振|さんしん}した。
examples.english: The batter swung late on the fastball and struck out.

notes:
USAGE:
A baseball term. Japan measures pitch speed in kilometers per hour (キロ). A fastball over 150 km/h (~93 mph) is considered very fast. Opposite of {変化球|へんかきゅう} (breaking ball).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {速球|そっきゅう}を{投|な}げる: to throw a fastball
- {速球|そっきゅう}{派|は}: power pitcher (fastball-oriented)
- {剛速球|ごうそっきゅう}: blazing fastball
- {速球|そっきゅう}と{変化球|へんかきゅう}: fastballs and breaking balls
